requirement: R7 - correlations from officially sourced numbers, n published
rules: Every value is computed from numbers an official page printed.
Every row states its n. A row that cannot state one carries no value.
Club-level correlation is a different quantity from leg-level dependence and is labelled as such.

rows.quantity: Same-game dependence: home win vs over the league mean total
rows.level: Leg level (two legs in one game)
rows.method: Phi coefficient on the 2x2 joint outcome table
rows.provenance: Official final scores for 137 games; the threshold is the league mean total of 45.9197 points, itself derived from the same official scores
rows.note: This is the quantity a same-game parlay price depends on. Both legs use only official numbers, so the estimate needs no model.

rows.quantity: Dependence between a leg and itself (the same event twice)
rows.method: Not estimated. Two legs on the same event cannot disagree, so the dependence is 1 by definition.
rows.provenance: Definition, not measurement. Recorded so that a slip built this way is never priced as if its legs were independent.
rows.note: Included because it is the failure mode that matters: a two-leg slip built from one event looks like a parlay and is not one.

rows.quantity: Cross-game dependence: two home-win legs in the same week
rows.level: Leg level (two legs in different games, same week)
rows.method: Phi coefficient over every unordered pair of games played in the same week
rows.provenance: Official final scores; 963 game pairs drawn from 10 weeks
rows.note: Legs in different games share a week, so a common shock can move them together. The estimate is small, but with this n the interval is wide.
A negative value would mean blowouts tend to be low scoring. It is a description of the season, not a betting relationship.

rows.quantity: Club points scored per game against points allowed per game
rows.provenance: Official standings read on 2026-11-14; PF and PA divided by games played
rows.mechanical_caveat: Both series are built from the same club's same games, so the pair is not two independent measurements. Published as a description of the season, not as evidence.

rows.quantity: Pythagorean expectation against actual win percentage
rows.provenance: Official standings read on 2026-11-14; the exponent 2.37 is a published convention, not fitted here
rows.mechanical_caveat: Pythagorean expectation is computed from the same points-for and points-against that decide the games, so a high correlation is a validity check on the formula, not a discovery.

rows.quantity: Forecast home margin against actual home margin (walk-forward)
rows.provenance: Official final scores; the forecast is built only from weeks before each game, so all 121 pairs are out of sample
rows.note: The one correlation that carries information about the model rather than about the season.
Near zero here is the reason the totals board scores 50.4% against its own number (see backtest SB-09). Forecast residual SD 14.654893 points.

rows.quantity: Player prop to team outcome dependence
rows.provenance: No per-game player log, target share or snap count was retrieved from any official source. The official injury report prints a status, not a usage number, so both series are missing.
rows.note: Blank by rule. A number here would be a guess presented as a measurement.

rows.provenance: Only 8 weeks carry enough games to build a three-leg slip, and the joint cell counts are too small to estimate a dependence. Published blank rather than estimated from 8 slips.
rows.note: Blank by rule. A number here would be a guess presented as a measurement.
